name: Natural Selection 2
author: community@example.invalid
description: Natural Selection 2 native Linux dedicated server (Steam app 4940). Anonymous SteamCMD install, automatic updates, and configurable vanilla maps/mods.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the NS2 server browser. Maximum 80 characters; control characters, double quotes, and backslashes are rejected by the startup wrapper.

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: Active player slots. The NS2 engine hard limit is 24. The game is mainly single-thread limited; larger servers need high per-core CPU speed.

variables.name: Spectator Slots
variables.description: Additional spectator slots. 0 disables dedicated spectator slots; accepted range is 0-24.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional player password. Leave blank for a public server. Maximum 64 characters; control characters, double quotes, and backslashes are rejected.

variables.name: Workshop Mod IDs
variables.description: Optional space-separated hexadecimal Workshop IDs for -mods. Example: 706D242. MapCycle.json can also define decimal UGC IDs and per-map mods.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: 1 updates app 4940 through SteamCMD every time the container starts; 0 starts the installed build without checking Steam.

variables.name: Validate on Startup
variables.description: 1 makes SteamCMD validate all app files during each automatic update; 0 performs a normal update check. Validation is slower and may restore changed game files.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Natural Selection 2 Dedicated Server app ID.

variables.name: Steam User
variables.description: App 4940 currently installs anonymously; no personal Steam account is required.

variables.name: Windows Install
variables.description: Native Linux server files are required.
